recognize_zh: CD79a 染色中腫瘤細胞大多陰性或僅有極淡的細胞質染色，只有中央一個細胞呈強烈環狀陽性（內部對照）；漿母細胞淋巴瘤常見 CD79a 弱陽性、部分陽性或陰性，所以 B 細胞標記缺失不可據以排除 B 細胞來源。
features: Monotonous sheet of tumor cells with round nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Tumor cells negative to at most faint, weak cytoplasmic CD79a staining
Single strongly positive cell with ring-like cytoplasmic staining acting as internal control
describe_en: CD79a immunostain shows the neoplastic cells to be largely negative, with at most faint, weak cytoplasmic staining in a subset. A rare admixed cell displays strong cytoplasmic positivity, confirming staining adequacy. Plasmablastic lymphoma frequently shows weak, partial or absent CD79a, reflecting loss of the mature B-cell program. The findings are compatible with EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma when interpreted with MUM1/CD138 positivity and EBER in situ hybridization.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows strong, diffuse CD79a together with CD20/PAX5, unlike the weak or absent CD79a of plasmablastic lymphoma.
Myeloma may be CD79a negative or weak as well, so it is separated by clinical/serologic features and usual EBER negativity.
CD79a negativity may suggest a non-B lineage, which is excluded by absence of CD3/CD2/CD56 and presence of MUM1/CD138 and immunoglobulin light-chain restriction.
